title: A Goodbye Kiss, a Hello Kiss
overview: Yuri is an ordinary teenage girl, until she's dragged to the ancient Hittite Empire—and marked for sacrifice!

title: The Black Water
overview: Yuri discovers that the only way to return home is to risk her life and retrieve her old clothes from Nakia.

title: I Can't Go Back, I Won't Go Back
overview: Yuri finally has everything she needs to go home. But Tito's fate changes everything she's fighting for.

title: Ishtar Incarnate
overview: Yuri accompanies Kail to battle in Alinna, where she faces danger from foes and purported friends alike!

title: A Sword to Fight
overview: A mysterious old man forces Yuri to battle the ruthless warrior Zuwa, with the weapon of her choosing.

title: The One I Can't Love
overview: Prince Zannanza is struck by a spell from Nakia that drives him to act on his darkest desires.

title: Cold Lips
overview: Ambushed by the Prince of Darkness, Yuri has to cut through enemy lines to save the kingdom of Kizzuwatna.

title: Under the Apple Tree
overview: Kail is ordered to destroy the Mitanni, but he refuses to let Yuri join him until Zannanza intervenes.

title: The Sign on the Palm
overview: The Dark Prince has occupied Malatya, but Kail and Yuri slip inside the city to bring it down.

title: Ishtar Purloined
overview: The Dark Prince takes Yuri prisoner, and he condemns her to death in a coliseum to prove she's not Ishtar.
